headline: Real Estate: Transfer Tax for Buyers from Third Countries to Increase Fivefold from July 1, 2027 - Dnews
summary: A new Greek regulation would raise the property transfer tax fivefold for non-EU buyers from July 1, 2027. Bank of Greece data show about €1.2 billion was invested in such purchases in 2025.
why: Transfer taxes change the cost of buying property and can affect foreign demand in the housing market and related real estate investment.
